title: Block-decode headline over a dot-screen globe
summary: A square two-colour event poster: a three-line headline decodes glyph by glyph from solid blocks through coarse mosaic to crisp type in 1.7 s, over a static dot-screened globe, then holds 2.3 s.
use_when: Announcing an event, date or launch day as a square social post
A retro print or texture look with only two brand colours
A short loop where the type entrance is the only motion
Turning a static key visual into a 4 s animated poster

look.type_style: bold grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking, 3 left-aligned lines, cap size ~8 % H, line pitch ~10 % H, top-left at ~5.5 % margin

structure.shot: flat pink square, dot-screened globe cropped bottom right, small mark bottom right and ticket CTA bottom left; 3-line headline (event name 2 words, city 2 words, date 2 words) decodes top left
structure.motion: per glyph: solid foreground block the size of the glyph box, then 2-3 coarse mosaic steps with a mid-tone cell, then the crisp letter; glyphs resolve in random order inside each line; line 1 starts f0, line 2 f8, line 3 f18; line 3 done f32, line 2 done f40, first word of line 1 last at f50; steps are stepped (no easing), ~3-6 fr each

structure.shot: the same poster fully resolved and held: 3-line headline, dot-screened globe, mark and CTA corners
structure.motion: none: full hold 69 fr; the dot-screen globe does not animate (frame diff 0.00 from 2 s)

params.lines: 3 headline lines, 2 words each (name, place, date), <= 14 characters per line
params.image: one hero image (globe or product shot) rendered through the dot screen, cropped off the bottom-right edge
params.cta: small corner label with an icon, bottom left, <= 2 words
params.colors: background and ink: two brand colours only

notes: Decode times measured from 30 fps strips (1 fr). Proposed term (not in vocabulary): block-decode, glyph-by-glyph reveal from solid block via mosaic to letter. Image is a static ordered dot screen; corner mark and CTA are present from f0 and never move. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Not loopable: frame 0 has no headline.
